name: educational-homepage-fullstack
description: Fullstack project setup for educational socio-economic formations homepage

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm run install:backend && npm run install:frontend
scripts.dev: npx concurrently "npm run start:backend" "npm run start:frontend"
scripts.clean: node -e "const fs = require('fs'); ['node_modules', 'backend/node_modules', 'frontend/node_modules', 'backend/data/philosophy_chunks.json'].forEach(p => fs.rmSync(p, {recursive: true, force: true}))"
